brief:
Settlers attacked the village of Deir Abu Mashaal, northwest of Ramallah, burning Palestinian vehicles and spray-painting hostile slogans, the Ma'an news agency reported. The assault occurred as part of a broader pattern of settler violence targeting Palestinian communities in the occupied West Bank.

The village has faced repeated incursions by Israeli settlers in recent years. Residents reported damage to multiple cars and property during the overnight raid.
title: Settlers torch Palestinian vehicles, spray hate graffiti in Deir Abu Mashaal raid
